text:
Alex K: Quick ops check — quiet window tonight 22:00 PT, target release v4.1.0. Can we confirm canary plan, smoke tests, and rollback gates?
Maria G: Release notes posted in Notion, migration flag is off by default. Feature rollout gated behind ff:v4_1_enable. Docs link: https://notion.redwood/release/v4.1.0
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v4.1.0 -> prod
  canary plan: 5% for 10m, 20% for 15m, 100% on success
  smoke: basic inference, auth, embedding pipeline
  command: `/deploy run --version v4.1.0 --canary 5%`
sre-oncall: I'll watch 2m P50/P95, error rate, and CPU on the serving fleet. Rollback triggers I want on the table:
  - 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m -> immediate rollback
  - request error spike > 1% in any region for 5m -> pause and investigate
  - p95 latency > 400ms for 5m -> pause (we can degrade to smaller model pool)
Julian R: Confirming model-serving image pinned in the rollout config to `inference:3.4.0` as fallback. If canary fails, deploy-bot should pin traffic back to `inference:3.3.8` (current prod).
Kate P: Can we run a short preflight smoke in prod shadowing for 15 minutes before canary cut? Quick command:
```
# run shadow traffic for 15m
shadowctl run --service inference --duration 15m --version v4.1.0
```
Alex K: Good call. Maria, are there any schema or DB migrations?
Maria G: No DB migrations. Minor config change (feature toggle). We have a migration checklist item anyway: cache warmup + kv prefetch.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:05 PT — 5% traffic. Monitoring alerts enabled.
sre-oncall: Observability runbook pinned: https://runbook.redwood/sre/rollouts. Oncall will escalate to ENG-PG if any of these hit: increased error budget burn or critical alarms.
Julian R: Rollback playbook (short):
  - `deploy-bot rollback --to version 3.3.8`
  - notify #incidents and the release owners
  - postmortem if rollback lasts > 30m
Kate P: If we hit high latency we can also switch to degradation path: reduce max tokens, force fast-quantized path, or divert to dedicated pool (if capacity). Decision owner: Alex K.
Alex K: Final checklist before go: everyone ack here, SRE has monitor, QA did canary smoke, Docs up, rollback command tested. Reply with :thumbsup: when you have acked.
Maria G: :thumbsup:
Julian R: :thumbsup: (rollback command tested in staging)
Kate P: :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll be on watch.
deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 20% at 22:20 PT — no alerts.
Alex K: If we make it to 100% without alerts, we mark the release as complete and close the quiet window. If we see any sustained sign of regression, follow the rollback playbook.
Maria G: Logging a quick post-release eval task: compare embeddings quality wrapper vs. baseline on the 500-case smoke set at +1h.
Alex K: Thanks team — will post a short readout in 30m.
